# Synthetic prior-producer checkpoint

`producer-708d.json` was generated by the actual SourceService acquisition at commit
708d113442f29395655d9abf6ac0a29026f1f44c using one authored Binance catalog
response without a body field, an isolated MemoryRepository, and MockTransport at
the declared external collector seam. It is newly authored regression evidence,
not a captured provider payload or a production record. The original output and
script are retained in local `source-s09-old-producer.log`,
`source-s09-old-producer.py`, and `source-s09-old-produced.json` evidence.

The prior producer stored text as an empty string before detail acquisition.
The restart test loads this exact recorded format unchanged; the current feed
configuration is not used to reconstruct its missing summary/body facts.
